info.name: DoSelect JSON Server - GET APIs
info.description: Only GET requests: every read API of the DoSelect JSON Server, one request per step of QA_GUIDE.md (flows A-D, the GET checks of flow F, and G1). Each request checks the expected result from the guide, not just a 2xx. Sends no POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE, so it is safe on every environment. Set baseUrl (collection variables) to the environment under test.

item.name: B1 - List every dataset
item.description: GET /api/<dataset> for each of the 9 datasets, with the record count from the guide.

item.name: B2-B5 - Get by id
item.description: Get by id for the 7 datasets that have an id, and the 404 cases.
